title: Modernise legacy tools and reporting without disturbing store operations, with margin data locked to the right roles
subtitle: Draft staffing revision - candidate evidence, scope and rates require owner confirmation

slides.title: A 22-week delivery plan with explicit staffing capacity and price
bullets: **Outcome measured in your ledger, not in hypothetical hours:** named legacy tools and reports switched off, and their running costs removed (target list agreed in month 1)
**Margin data protected by design:** row- and role-level security on by default; margin figures visible only to roles your business owners approve; access tested before every go-live
**Stable daily operations:** releases outside store peak hours and campaign weeks, parallel running, tested rollback per app
**Team that works your way:** Finnish-speaking, on site in Mäntsälä 2 days per week, follows your central office routines
**Builds on what you have:** your BI tool, public cloud and ERP programme; no new licences; the target stack is confirmed with you in phase 1
**Draft EUR 218,625 capacity fee** across three gates; confirm scope and risk allowance before a binding fixed-price commitment.

slides.title: Margin figures stay with the people entitled to them: access is closed by default and tested
bullets: **Deny by default:** a new report or app shows nothing until a role grants it. Margin and purchase-price columns are classed as sensitive and hidden unless the role allows them.
Access rules live in code, and an automated test runs on every release: "store supervisor cannot see department margin" fails the release if broken.

slides.title: Three gated phases fit around retail seasons
table: Inventory, role matrix, ledger-cost baseline per tool, data-access probe on 3 priority tools, go/no-go risk report
You approve the list and access model
Data layer, priority reports, access tests, parallel run
Supervisor pilot in agreed stores; access tests pass; retirement targets set against each tool's baseline
Functional apps, remaining reports, switch-off, handover
Legacy tools switched off, ledger lines removed
slides.note: No go-lives during Christmas season or major campaign weeks; freeze calendar agreed with store operations in phase 1.
